name: Ryoujoku Hitozuma Club
source:
Main character works as instructor at a membership fitness club "JOY", but his clients are all old women. However, his colleague Mizuho has young beautiful women as customers. Eventually Mizuho gives up and agrees to give three of her clients to protagonist. And he enthusiastically starts their training.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在会员制健身俱乐部“JOY”担任教练，可他的客户全是年长女性。相比之下，同事瑞穗的客户都是年轻美女。最终，瑞穗放弃抵抗，同意把三名客户让给主人公，而他也热情地开始了训练。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-september-2008-sumaga.html]vndbreview[/url]]
